question: A and B together can complete (1)/(5) of a work in 4(4)/(5) days. A alone completes (3)/(4) of the work in 30 days. How long will B alone take to complete the whole work?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can complete (1)/(5) of a work in 4(4)/(5) days.

 A alone completes (3)/(4) of the work in 30 days.

**Concept used:**

Total work = Total number of workers × Total number of days 

Number of days = Total work / Efficiency

**Calculation:**

A and B together can complete (1)/(5) of work in 4(4)/(5) = 24 / 5 days

So, they do the total work in (24 / 5 ) &
